name: Alert
import: import { Alert, AlertTitle, AlertDescription, AlertActions } from '@theya/shadcn/ui/alert';
whenToUse: A message about this page or section that stays until it’s resolved.
A warning before an action, or the summary of errors after submitting a form.

whenNotToUse.text: A confirmation that something just happened
A decision that blocks the page

anatomy.description: the first child; matches the tone.
`dismissible` — only for messages that can safely go away.

do.caption: What happened, then what to do.
do.example: Payment failed Your card was declined. Update it to keep the site online after 12 November.

dont.caption: “Error” alone gives nothing to act on.

do.caption: Tone matches how serious it is.

dont.caption: Danger for news wears out the color for real problems.

<Alert tone="danger" className="w-80">

a11y: Appearing after an action? Set `live` (`polite`, or `assertive` for errors) so it’s announced. Static alerts don’t need it.
The tone is also in words (the title), not only in color and icon.
For a form error summary, move focus to the alert after submit.

props.name: indicator
props.description: Full-tone accent bar on the left edge. See `AlertIndicator`. Default `'none'`.

props.name: live
props.description: Announce as a live region when mounted dynamically. Omit for static banners.

props.name: shadow
props.description:
Adds `shadow-elevation-sm`. Off by default — an inline banner usually sits flush in
the page flow and doesn't need to lift off it; turn on for an alert
floating over content (e.g. a toast-like placement) instead of inline.
